Ugmuls 5.5e Automation · v0.7.2

New features
in the latest release.

The Battle Master update: maneuvers, Relentless, Great Weapon feats, and damage dice that roll together.

New in v0.7.2 · Battle Master

One attack.
A choice of maneuvers.

Use learned maneuvers from attack cards and damage Configuration, with the current Superiority Die, available Combat Superiority charges, and one maneuver per attack.

  • Precision Attack: add a die to a missed attack while retaining the original d20. Undo applied damage before adjusting the attack.
  • Trip Attack: add damage, prompt a Strength save for Large or smaller targets, and apply native Prone on failure.
  • Distracting Strike: add damage and grant advantage to the next attacker other than the Fighter.
  • Menacing Attack: add damage and prompt a Wisdom save, with native Frightened on failure.
  • Goading Attack: add damage and prompt a Wisdom save. Failure imposes disadvantage against creatures other than the Fighter through the end of the Fighter’s next turn, combining normally with advantage.
  • Maneuvering Attack: add damage and a reminder tag. Ally selection, reaction use, and movement remain manual.
  • Pushing Attack: add damage and a Strength save for Large or smaller targets, with a tag reminding the GM to move the target on failure.

Damage riders support critical hits; applicable effects keep Apply/Undo controls. Individual options are under Automations → Unique Classes → Fighter.

Battle Master details →

Level 15 feature

Spend the current die.
Or take the free d8.

Relentless adds a Superiority Die dropdown below Maneuver. The current d10 or d12 is the default; d8 — Free (Relentless) replaces the expenditure once per active combat turn. With no normal dice left, the free option is selected when available.

Precision Attack offers the same choice and shares the limit. A new creature’s turn makes the free use available again, including for qualifying reaction maneuvers. Previewing or canceling a roll does not spend the use.

Automations → Feats

Great weapons.
Connected damage.

  • Great Weapon Fighting: qualifying two-handed melee weapon attacks treat damage dice of 1 or 2 as 3, including attached riders and Savage Attacker pools. Versatile weapons require a two-handed attack.
  • Great Weapon Master: Heavy-weapon hits made with the Attack action on your turn offer proficiency-bonus damage. Bonus-action and reaction attacks are excluded; Hew stays manual.

Feat automation details →

Cards and fixes

Roll together.
See what applied.

  • Weapon and rider damage dice animate together in one Dice So Nice throw when resolving pending damage.
  • Goading, Maneuvering, Pushing, and Relentless tags carry reminder tooltips on damage cards.
  • Goading now participates in native turn-end expiry tracking. Existing Goading effects are repaired when the active GM reloads.
  • Great Weapon Fighting handles nested dice previews and keeps its minimum through normal/critical corrections.

Hard-refresh GM and player clients after updating.
